specs.head_height_rule: Frontal view of the full face (official portal does not state a head % range)
specs.notes: Official Passport Seva portal FAQ/Guide (verified live 2026-08-12 by rendering the portal): 'Passport size coloured photographs (4.5 cm length x 3.5 cm width) with white background'. Printed photos are required for minors under 4, Camp applications and Diplomatic/Official forms; ordinary adult applicants have the photo captured digitally at the PSK. Black & white, polaroid, dark glasses and uniform photos are not accepted. Overseas applications (e.g. from the US/Canada through VFS Global or Indian missions) use the official overseas spec: 2x2 in (51x51 mm) colour photograph, head height 25-35 mm (about 50-69% of photo height), plain white background, no retouching - verified 2026-08-17 against VFS Global's India passport services photo specification PDF (https://visa.vfsglobal.com/one-pager/india/united-states-of-america/passport-services/pdf/photo-specifiation.pdf).
specs.official_source: passportindia.gov.in — Passport Seva official portal (FAQ & Guides)

specs.head_height_rule: Passport-standard: full face visible; official portal does not publish a head % range
specs.notes: India driving licence photo requirements (Sarathi/Parivahan portal; cross-checked 2026-08-20 against multiple independent compliance tools: ilovephoto.in, idphotosnap.com, visafoto.com, passport-size-photo.com): 35x45 mm, white background, 300 DPI, 20-50 KB for the Sarathi/Parivahan online upload. Direct crawl of the official portal was blocked by anti-bot protection on 2026-08-20 - pending human re-verify at sarathi.parivahan.gov.in. We deliver a 413x531 px upload file tuned to 20-50 KB plus a 4x6 in print sheet (4 per sheet) for RTO physical submissions.
specs.official_source: Parivahan Sarathi - online driving licence portal (photo upload)

specs.head_height_rule: Head height (top of hair to chin) about 31.5 mm; 5 mm from top of photo to top of hair
specs.notes: Standard Chinese passport photo. Official embassy guidance cited by the visa/passport application centres.

specs.head_height_rule: Head height about 356 px; 25 px from top of photo to top of hair
specs.notes: Online photo for the Chinese visa application form (white background, JPEG 40-120 KB). Paper applications and visa centres use the printed 33x48 mm photo. US, UK and Canadian citizens may enter visa-free for up to 240 hours (10 days) under the visa-free transit policy — see the transit check on this page. Always confirm current rules on the official National Immigration Administration website (nia.gov.cn) or your nearest Chinese embassy before booking.

specs.head_height_rule: Head height 32–36 mm (=71–80% of the 45 mm height, official spec text quoted by visafoto).
specs.notes: Madagascar e-Visa available online for US, UK and Canada citizens. Official portal evisamada.gov.mg (the only official site; evisamada-mg.com is a commercial proxy) was unreachable from abroad on 2026-08-17 — TLS handshake reset via US egress proxy; external fetcher r.jina.ai also timed out. Official spec text as quoted by visafoto: printed photo 35–45 mm wide × 45–55 mm high, head height 32–36 mm, plain white background, eyes open looking straight at the camera; glasses only for medical reasons (doctor's letter required). Our 35×45 mm output is within the official range; the 32–36 mm head-height rule maps to our 70–80% head-height check (71–80% of 45 mm).
specs.official_source: Madagascar e-Visa — evisamada.gov.mg (unreachable from abroad 2026-08-17; official spec text via visafoto quoting official requirements)

specs.head_height_rule: Passport-standard head height
specs.notes: Azerbaijan ASAN e-Visa available online for US, UK and Canada citizens. OFFICIAL FLOW CHECK (2026-08-17): the official 'Conditions for issuing electronic visas' page (evisa.gov.az/en/conditions) states the application attaches 'the scanned page of a travel document with a photo' (passport bio page); no standalone photo upload is specified on the official portal or public pages. Per project policy (Turkey precedent: no photo field → no photo product), EXCLUDED from the product lineup. 35×45 mm entry kept for reference only.

coverage_note: Entries with verified_date=2026-08-17 were checked against official government portals in a live browser (2026-08-17). Where an official portal does not publish pixel dimensions, the notes state the official requirement (e.g. 'passport-sized photo') and the cross-check source. az_visa is documented for reference only — the official ASAN e-visa flow does not require a standalone photo upload, so no product is offered for it.
